svg.title: NK cell
svg.desc: Round NK lymphocyte with an indented nucleus and a small set of dark cytotoxic granules. Biological basis: NK cells are large granular lymphocytes; perforin- and granzyme-containing lysosomal granules polarize toward target-cell contacts.
